_note: Prototype (#287): detailed pack trees (assets-private/synty/glb/nature) near the player in place of the baked box/pyramid trees. Without the pack, or with DRYCASTLE_PACK_TREES=0, nothing changes. near_m: a tile whose centre is this close to the player gets pack trees and loses its baked trees. fade_m: the pack tile fades out over this band past near_m (the tile is freed at the end of it). tile_m: the tile edge, one MultiMesh per model and tile; also the granularity at which baked trees are hidden. release_m: a baked props node cut into tiles is put back in one piece when it is this far past near_m + fade_m. rescan_m / max_builds_per_call / budget_ms: streaming, as for the meadow (a split of a baked node counts as a build). shadows: pack trees cast shadows like the baked ones. shapes: the models that stand in for the tree shapes of trees.json (cone, box), by name in nature/manifest.json, chosen by a hash of the tree's position in proportion to weight; a name the pack does not have is skipped.
